result:
Both typecheck and the full test suite pass cleanly.

I throttled `POST /login` in `routes/auth.ts` by attaching `@guren/core`'s built-in `createRateLimitMiddleware({ limit: 5, windowMs: 60_000, trustProxy: false })` to that route only. The middleware counts every submission (right or wrong password) against an in-memory, per-process store keyed by client IP; `trustProxy: false` keeps it from trusting forwarded-for headers (matching the "no proxy in dev" requirement) and its built-in fallback treats an unresolvable IP as one shared bucket, so it fails closed rather than letting unthrottled traffic through. On the 6th attempt within a minute it returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header, exactly as the library does out of the box — no custom middleware needed. `GET /login`, registration, and every other route are untouched since the middleware is only wired onto that one route. I added `tests/LoginController.test.ts`, which primes CSRF, submits 5 bad-password attempts (each getting the normal 422), confirms the 6th gets a 429 with `Retry-After`, confirms a subsequent attempt is still blocked, and confirms `GET /login` keeps working while throttled — all passing alongside the existing suite, with `bun run typecheck` clean.
